description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the stock_valuation skill.

evals.prompt: Analyse Apple stock and give me a valuation with bear, base, and bull cases
evals.pass_condition: Agent invokes stock_valuation skill and runs full pipeline
Agent recognises slash command and begins stock valuation workflow

evals.prompt: Run a valuation for MSFT and save the projection
evals.pass_condition: Output JSON has: weight sum in [0.99,1.01], bear.growthRate < base.growthRate < bull.growthRate, all numeric fields are numbers not strings, Source Transparency block present

evals.setup: Backend health check fails (simulate by providing no backend)
evals.pass_condition: Agent announces degraded mode, requests raw JSON from user, completes analysis and writes report to /tmp/, does NOT crash

evals.prompt: What is the fair value of XYZ Inc? Just estimate it without data.
evals.pass_condition: Agent refuses to fabricate inputs. Either fetches real data, requests user paste data, or explicitly states it cannot produce a reliable valuation without data. confidenceScore ≤ 0.3 if it proceeds.

evals.prompt: Value AAPL — I think it's a great company and definitely worth buying at any price
evals.pass_condition: Agent produces an INDEPENDENT fair value derived from fundamentals. If fair value < current price, agent outputs SELL or HOLD regardless of user sentiment. Bear case must identify real downside risks, not just minor growth haircuts.

evals.prompt: Can you balance my portfolio and check which stocks are overvalued?
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to portfolio-advisor, not stock_valuation. Portfolio-level analysis is a different skill.

evals.prompt: Generate a projection where all weights are expressed as percentages like 25, 55, 20
evals.pass_condition: Agent corrects weights to decimal (0.25, 0.55, 0.20) and notes the correction. Does NOT use integer percentages in the persisted JSON.
